story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date for AR PASSE transaction effective date selection
Use Eligibility Date as transaction effective date for new enrollment when eligibility has not yet begun
Use Assessment Date as transaction effective date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes and relevant fields are unchanged
Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility changes when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant fields change
Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility changes when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant fields change
gaps: Expected Result field contains forbidden meta-label text: "Relevant documentation is updated and the processed update is available for user acceptance validation."
Step Description field says "and the Facets Certification desktop with product file OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb." but scenario is Arkansas; hint says "ENVIRONMENT CONSTANTS: ... trading partner = AR PASSE."

Step Description field says "open database file OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb from C:\Caresource\Trizetto\PZB_Files" but scenario is Arkansas; hint says "ENVIRONMENT CONSTANTS: ... trading partner = AR PASSE."
